test_name: TEST 1: Continuity & Anaphoric Reference Resolution ('it', 'this machine', memory recall)

turns.reply:
The Epson SureColor SC-P6500D is a dedicated print-only model with a maximum print width of 24 inches. It supports continuous dual-roll commercial photo & poster production using 350ml and 700ml ink tanks. The printer handles various media types including Glossy, Semi-Gloss, Luster, Matte, Baryta, and Fine Art museum canvas.

*(Verified from official catalogue: LARGE FORMAT PRINTERS FOR PHOTOGRAPHY_CATALOG.pdf)*
The Epson SureColor SC-P6500D includes full network connectivity, featuring SuperSpeed USB 3.0, Gigabit Ethernet (1000Base-T), and Wi-Fi (IEEE 802.11b/g/n) with Wi-Fi Direct.
